{{Quote|Prepare for attack!|General Grievous prior to exchanging broadsides with the ''Guarlara''|audio=PrepareForAttack-ROTS.flac|<ref name="Episode III" />}}
The '''''Guarlara''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Fifth Fleet]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy|naval forces']] [[Open Circle Fleet]], and participated in the [[Battle of Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY]]. During the battle, the ''Guarlara'' crossed paths with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|naval forces]] [[flagship]], the [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]] ''[[Invisible Hand]]'', which resulted in a brief confrontation between the two [[warship]]s.

Amid the confrontation between the two, the [[Star Destroyer]] suffered extensive damage to its [[hull]], while also dealing heavy damage to the Separatist [[dreadnought]]. In dealing extensive damage to the dreadnought by striking one of its gun magazines, the ''Guarlara'' caused the ''Invisible Hand'' to plummet towards the surface of the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].

==Description==
A [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]],<ref name="Episode III" /> the ''Guarlara''<ref name="Front Lines">''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]''</ref> possessed two [[Bridge (starship)|bridges]], as well as eight [[engine]] units. The [[Star Destroyer]] was also armed with several legless [[AV-7 Anti-vehicle Artillery Cannon]] located at the ship's starboard side,<ref name="Episode III" /> eight [[DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turret]]s (four port, four starboard), and two medium dual [[turbolaser]] [[cannon]]s.<ref name="Weapons note" /> Furthermore, either side of the ''Guarlara''{{'s}} hull was emblazoned with the symbol of the [[Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy|naval forces']] [[Open Circle Fleet]], and was painted with five [[Color|red]] stripes on its port and starboard wings in order to signify its allegiance to the Republic Navy's [[Fifth Fleet]].<ref name="Note" /> The ''Guarlara'' also shared its name with a [[Guarlara|creature]] indigenous to the [[grass]]lands of [[Naboo]].<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|All batteries, fire! Fire!|Captain Lushros Dofine, after the ''Guarlara'' strikes the ''Invisible Hand''|audio=AllBatteriesFire-ROTS.flac|<ref name="Episode III" />}}
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars]] between the Galactic Republic and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Confederacy had launched an unprecedented [[Battle of Coruscant|attack]] on the Republic [[capital]] [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], led by the [[Kaleesh]] Separatist [[General]] [[Grievous]]. During the battle, Grievous managed to kidnap [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] and take him captive aboard the Separatist [[flagship]], the [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]], ''[[Invisible Hand]]'', which resulted in the immediate recall of Republic forces from all across [[the galaxy]] back to Coruscant in order to aid in the defense of the planet. As a result, the ''Guarlara'' and over a thousand other ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers of the Open Circle Fleet arrived in the system with the intent of destroying as many Separatist [[warship]]s as possible.<ref name="Front Lines" />

[[File:Prepare-for-attack.png|thumb|left|270px|The ''Guarlara'' approaches the ''Invisible Hand'' amid the Battle of Coruscant.]]
As the space battle over Coruscant continued to rage, the ''Guarlara'' crossed paths with the ''Invisible Hand'', which had previously suffered severe damage to its [[deflector shield]]s. While cruising by the Separatist [[dreadnought]]'s starboard side, the Venator's turbolasers turned and aimed at the ''Invisible Hand'', resulting in a brief broadside engagement between the two after the ''Guarlara'' fired one of its cannons on the dreadnought. As the two warships bombarded one another, causing extensive damage to each other's hulls, the ''Invisible Hand'' managed to destroy the Venator's starboard medium dual turbolaser cannon, while also blasting a hole in its starboard hull, which resulted in the destruction of several of its cannons and the deaths of several [[clone trooper]]s from the [[41st Elite Corps]] manning the [[turret]]s.<ref name="Episode III" />

Endlessly bombarding each other, one of the ''Guarlara''{{'s}} DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turrets were destroyed by the Separatist dreadnought. However, it was the Venator who emerged triumphant by landing a direct hit on a [[flak gun]]'s magazine aboard the ''Invisible Hand'', causing it and most of the gun deck to explode. As a result, the dreadnought lost stability in orbit and began to plummet towards the surface of the planet as its crew attempted to regain control. Despite the damage caused by the ''Guarlara'', the ''Invisible Hand'' managed to regain stability and continued to cruise in orbit of the planet.<ref name="Episode III" />

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Guarlara'' was operated by a crew of [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]]s from the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]'s 41st Elite Corps. The clone troopers were responsible for manning the Star Destroyer's armament, such as its AV-7 Anti-vehicle Artillery Cannons.<ref name="Episode III" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Guarlara'' was introduced in the [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="ROTS date">{{SW|url=news/critical-opinion-revenge-of-the-sith-original-reviews|text=Critical Opinion: ''Revenge of the Sith'' Original Reviews}}</ref> It was later first identified in ''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'', a [[2017]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Front Lines" /> The [[Guarlara (Venator-class)/Legends|''Guarlara'']] was originally identified in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the entry for the [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]],<ref name="Trade Federation cruiser">{{DB|starship|tradefederationcruiser|Trade Federation cruiser}}</ref> which was released on [[May 4]], 2005 in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Date">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20050504.html|text=A Stab at the Heart}}</ref>
